description: A task type is declared once here and read everywhere — the rep's form, the task list, Smart Views, automation and the workflow engine. It is configured top-down: grain, enforcement, fields, then rules.

fields.description: The name reps see, and the grain that scopes it. Every picker, permission and workflow offer is scoped by vertical · group · program, and a lead outside the grain is refused this activity at save.
fields.label: Identity & Grain

fields.description: Grain axis. Blank means any value on that axis. The composite key is vertical::group::program::type_name, so one type name can carry a different schema per grain.
fields.label: Vertical

fields.description: Everything that may block a bad save is declared here and nowhere else: when a location is demanded, whether submitting the form completes the task, and whether bulk completion is allowed.
fields.label: Enforcement

fields.description: In-Person marks the activity as a visit, which demands a location at save. Blank or Phone marks it as one that does not.
fields.label: Visit Mode

fields.description: Location is demanded at save when this field's answer satisfies the condition below. Only a question declared under Fields may be named. Left blank, Visit Mode alone decides.
fields.label: Location Required When

fields.description: How the answer is compared. The same four operators the Rules grid offers, so a condition reads the same wherever it is declared.
fields.label: Operator
fields.options:
is
is not
is set
is not set

fields.description: The answer compared against, offered from the chosen field's own options. Ignored by `is set` and `is not set`.
fields.label: Value

fields.description: The task is completed the moment its form is submitted. Left off, the type is a plain open to-do.
fields.label: Logged Complete

fields.description: Completion is forced through the form, one task at a time. The list's bulk action refuses a task of this type.
fields.label: Disable Bulk Complete

fields.description: One row is added per question the form asks, and row order is form order. Source declares whose data is captured, Section and Target where the answer is filed, Required whether it is always mandatory.
fields.label: Fields

fields.description: Per-type form fields, rendered in order. Empty = the type is a plain task (no activity form).
fields.label: Schema

fields.description: One row declares one reaction of the form: when a field's answer matches, every listed target is shown, hidden or made mandatory. A blank When declares the form's opening state.
fields.label: Rules

name: CRM Task Type
